description: Retrieve quarterly Call Report financial data for an FDIC-insured institution. Returns total assets, deposits, equity, net income, ROA, ROE, net interest margin, and efficiency ratio.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number for the institution

limit.description: Number of quarterly periods to return, max 20 (default 4)

name: fdic.institutions.financials

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Bank Financial Reports
